hook: Just 19 percent of online encyclopedia biographies feature women.

sections.voiceover: Just 19 percent of online encyclopedia biographies feature women.
sections.visual_cue: Digital statistics display showing 19 percent on screen.

sections.voiceover: In October 2026, Sandi Toksvig and the University of Cambridge launched the Mappa Mundi project. How can this interactive digital atlas challenge Wikipedia's overwhelming gender bias?
sections.visual_cue: University of Cambridge building exterior and archival map footage.

sections.voiceover: Worse still, 18 countries even let men prohibit wives from working.
sections.visual_cue: Global map highlighting legal restriction zones.

sections.voiceover: Pilot studies in the United Kingdom and Afghanistan spotlight 0.5 percent of history attributed to women. Cambridge researchers use the interactive atlas to challenge Wikipedia's digital gender bias.
sections.visual_cue: Atlas interface displaying pilot study regions.

text_overlay.text: Pilot Studies in UK and Afghanistan

sections.voiceover: Only 19 percent remains the baseline for online biographies.
sections.visual_cue: Final percentage graphic on dark background.
